failures.question: 用英文类目名统计退款金额，哪些类目退款最多？取前 15。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri
  ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
 AND ri.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi
  ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id
 AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct
  ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE r.status = 4
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY refund_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;
failures.firstSql:

       ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri
  ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
 AND ri.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi
  ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id
 AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

failures.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
-- 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计商品数量
select w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name, count(distinct i.product_id) as product_count
from inventory i
join warehouses w on w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
join regions r on r.region_code = w.region_code
join products p on p.product_id = i.product_id
join product_brand_map pbm on pbm.product_id = p.product_id and pbm.is_current
join brands b on b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
where i.quantity < i.safety_stock
group by 1, 2, 3
order by product_count desc
limit 20;
